prompt_style: photoreal cinematic still for first-frame video handoff
camera_defaults: 35mm or 50mm lens, motivated composition, clear focal subject
lighting_defaults: physically plausible motivated light, controlled contrast, practicals if present
quality_terms: visible skin/material texture, natural asymmetry, lens falloff, grounded shadows, continuity-safe framing
negative_prompt: deformed anatomy, extra fingers, duplicate limbs, warped face, text artifacts, watermark, compression artifacts, low detail
